items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 28 September 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure covers the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 3 or 4, backing South through this morning and afternoon, then backing and increasing Southeast 4 or 5 later in the evening. Further increasing Southeast 5 or 6 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building slight or moderate tonight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 during the morning. Little change for the rest of the day, then veering South or Southeast 5 or 6 later tomorrow night.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, building moderate or rough.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.
